evidence.observed_facts: The statutory list covers the full 2027 year. Two rules can move a day: art. 234.º n.º 2 allows Good Friday to be observed on another Easter-period day with local meaning, and n.º 3 allows specific legislation to move a holiday to the following Monday. No 2027 instrument applying either rule to Lisbon was found, so the dates are stored as the statutory calendar with those conditions open.

currency_assumptions: Native prices are EUR. The USD comparison uses the ECB euro reference rate of 2026-11-24: EUR 1 = USD 1.0963.
A rate printed 'IVA incluído' is treated as gross; no VAT is added on top. No net-priced room was relied on.
A base USD figure models eight billed hours at the published hourly rate; it is a comparison, not a quote, and no programme cost is claimed while the window is unknown.
The soft budget is USD 5,000; exactly 5,000 is not over budget and cost is never a gate.

declared_gaps.text: The Câmara Municipal de Lisboa municipal-holiday page could not be read on 2026-11-26: www.lisboa.pt returned a Cloudflare bot-verification loop. The 13 June municipal date therefore rests on the secondary calendar plus the statutory rule (Lei 75/2013; art. 235.º), not on the Câmara page itself.
The DGERT 2027 holiday list was not available on 2026-11-26: dgert.gov.pt/feriados returned “Error establishing a database connection”. No DGERT row is claimed.

School rows are Despacho n.º 8368/2024 Anexo II only (public pre-school/basic/secondary). The private special-education Anexo IV differs (e.g. Easter 25 March–2 April 2027, Christmas 20–24 December 2027) and is not applied to the public layer. Summer is not an Anexo II interruption and is not stored as a school row; Anexo I term ends (4/11/30 June 2027) are recorded in coverage evidence only.

Ten records across nine address groups resolve only to street tier because the operator prints no door number or the geocoder has no house-number match: Heden Santa Apolónia and Heden Alvalade, Nova SBE, Lisbon Stage, Second Home, Universidade de Lisboa, ISCTE, Universidade Católica, São Luiz, and Musicbox. No exact pin is claimed for them.

Only 11 of 51 venues carry a usable photo after the refresh, and only 7 of those carry at least one room-specific view, so 44 venues have no room-specific photo. Operator galleries for Convento do Beato, Lisbon Stage, Marriott, Pestana and Heden could not be placed to a room (cookie wall, JS shell or no room caption); their prior Commons building exteriors remain labelled fallbacks.

No venue publishes a 09:00–21:00 bookable interval. All 50 live rooms/venues are unknown; MAAT’s Boiler Room is “no” because the operator says it is available only after 19:00 and not on Tuesdays. Administrative office hours and public museum hours were not treated as hire windows. No published noise curfew was found on the pages read, so none is recorded as a cap.

LX Factory’s operator domain returned an obfuscated anti-bot shell; its address is from a directory listing (R. Rodrigues de Faria 103, 1300-501) and is flagged secondary. Musicbox’s operator domain is parked and Time Out reports the venue closed in 2025; its pin marks the former address.

Titanic Sur Mer’s operator domains fail DNS; its address and coordinates come from the DICE venue page structured data. Older listings print Cais da Ribeira Nova, Armazém B rather than Cais do Gás; both are in the same riverside complex and the conflict is recorded on the claim.

Luma’s three city/alias pages returned JavaScript shells (513–1,260 bytes) on 2026-11-26 and could not be read as calendars; only the two organiser Luma pages produced dates. Meetup pages show 2026-dated events only. The AI-Lisbon-27 directory page returned HTTP 429 and is not stored.

Postal-code conflicts are recorded rather than smoothed: CCL prints 1300-307 (OpenStreetMap returns 1300-037); Impact Hub prints 1170-070 (OSM 1170-079); Musicbox listings give 1200-292, 1200-019 and 1249-002. Street and number are stable in each case.

Two-branch brands were resolved by address, not by name: Heden’s five rooms are mapped to Rossio, Santa Apolónia and Alvalade addresses from the operator FAQ; Impact Hub is pinned to the Penha de França space (Rua Neves Ferreira 13), not the Baixa Chiado address; IDEA Spaces is the Saldanha space (Av. Defensores de Chaves 4), not the Aguiar or Parque das Nações branches.
Existing record IDs use the Lisbon prefix “lisbon-” (51 records) and were not renamed; no foreign city prefix is present. The card’s shorthand “lis-” is satisfied by the existing city prefix.

As of 2026-11-26, the 13 public-holiday dates for 2027 are derived from the art. 234.º statutory list plus the Gregorian computus (Easter Sunday 28 March 2027), not read from an official dated 2027 table; each row keeps derived: true. The PGDL consolidated text of Lei n.º 7/2009 is the captured authority for the list.

alcohol.quote: 1 - Os operadores económicos que vendam ou disponibilizem, com objetivos comerciais, bebidas alcoólicas devem respeitar as proibições e obrigações previstas no Decreto-Lei n.º 50/2013, de 16 de abril.
alcohol.source_locator: Art. 23.º n.º 1 — Restrições à venda de bebidas alcoólicas
alcohol.source_title: DL n.º 10/2015 — regime de acesso e exercício de atividades de comércio, serviços e restauração

translation_review.gloss: Economic operators that sell or make alcoholic drinks available for commercial purposes must respect the prohibitions and duties in Decree-Law 50/2013.
translation_review.review: The article routes alcohol duties to DL 50/2013; it does not itself grant a licence. Read as a pointer, not as permission.

value.observed_rule: Alcohol service is a regulated commercial activity; the operator (or its licensed caterer) must hold the applicable licence and follow DL 50/2013 restrictions.
value.unknown: Whether a private 09:00-21:00 event with a free evening beer needs any permit beyond the venue's own licence, and who applies if the venue has none.
value.venue_level: No venue in this store confirms an alcohol-service model; beer_allowed stays unknown.

verification_questions: Ask each venue who holds the alcohol licence, whether service can run to 21:00, and what insurance or security it requires.

food.quote: Sem prejuízo do disposto em regime especial, os estabelecimentos de venda ao público, de prestação de serviços e de restauração ou bebidas abrangidos pelo RJACSR devem observar o disposto no Decreto-Lei n.º 48/96, de 15 de maio, alterado pelos Decretos-Leis n.os 126/96, de 10 de agosto, 111/2010, de 15 de outubro, e 48/2011, de 1 de abril, quanto ao respetivo horário de funcionamento.
food.source_locator: Art. 31.º — Horários de funcionamento dos estabelecimentos
food.source_title: DL n.º 10/2015 — regime de acesso e exercício de atividades de comércio, serviços e restauração

translation_review.gloss: Without prejudice to a special regime, establishments covered by this law must observe Decree-Law 48/96, as amended, on their opening hours.
translation_review.review: The quoted article is about opening hours, not food safety. It is stored here because a catered evening depends on the venue's licensed hours; food-safety registration is a separate duty not evidenced by this capture.

value.observed_rule: Venue opening hours are set by the municipal regime in DL 48/96, so a 21:00 finish depends on the venue's licensed hours, not only its willingness.
value.unknown: Which caterers hold food-business registration for an off-site event, and whether the venue permits external catering at all.
value.venue_level: food_service and catering stay unknown for every assessed room; nothing here implies permission.

verification_questions: Confirm the venue's licensed closing hour and its external-catering and food-safety requirements in writing.

language.quote: Todas as informações sobre a natureza, características e garantias de bens ou serviços, oferecidos ao público no mercado nacional, quer os constantes de rótulos, embalagens, prospetos, catálogos ou livros de instruções ou outros meios informativos, quer as facultadas nos locais de venda ou divulgadas por qualquer meio publicitário têm de ser redigidas em língua portuguesa, nos termos do Decreto-Lei n.º 238/86, de 19 de agosto, alterado pelo Decreto-Lei n.º 42/88, de 6 de fevereiro.
language.source_title: DL n.º 10/2015 — regime de acesso e exercício de atividades de comércio, serviços e restauração

translation_review.gloss: All information on the nature, characteristics and guarantees of goods or services offered to the public in the national market must be written in Portuguese.
translation_review.review: Decision-bearing words (informação, oferecidos ao público, mercado nacional, redigidas em língua portuguesa) were read in the Portuguese; the article governs public commercial information, not internal working documents.

value.observed_rule: Public-facing commercial information must be in Portuguese; the venue pages read publish in both Portuguese and English.
value.unknown: Whether the event's own public programme page, signage and menus need Portuguese versions, and who owns that duty for a private event.
value.venue_level: Per-venue language_support records only what the operator publishes; no bilingual service is promised.

verification_questions: Confirm with each venue whether attendee-facing signage and menus can be supplied in Portuguese, and who translates them.
